raw_segments.text: Now are we well resolved, and by God's help and yours, the noble sinews of our power,
France being ours, will bend it to our awe, or break it all to pieces.
Or there will sit, ruling in large and ample empery over France and all her almost kingly
duketoms, or lay these bones in an unworthy urn, tombless, with no remembrance over them.
Either our history shall with full mouth speak freely of our acts, or else our grave, like
Turkish mute, shall have a tongueless mouth, not worshiped with a waxen epitaph.
